settings.question: Are all products made to order?
settings.answer: Most pieces are made after you order. Any piece that is already finished and ready to ship is labeled “Ready to ship” on its product page.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Standard pieces take about [X–Y] business days to make before shipping. Engraved or personalized pieces take about [X–Y] business days. Shipping time is separate and depends on your address and shipping method, which you’ll see at checkout.

settings.question: Will my item look exactly like the photo?
settings.answer: Not exactly. Every piece is made from real wood, so grain, color, and figure vary. The photos show the style, shape, and finish you can expect. Your piece will be one of a kind.

settings.question: Can I request a different wood species?
settings.answer: If a product lists wood choices, pick one on the product page. For a wood that isn’t listed, contact Ed before ordering. Availability depends on what’s in the shop.

settings.question: Can I personalize or engrave my order?
settings.answer: Products that offer engraving or personalization show those fields on the product page, along with the character limit. [ENGRAVING METHOD AND ANY EXTRA COST, if applicable.] Please check spelling carefully, since engraved pieces are made exactly as entered.

settings.question: Can I place a custom order?
settings.answer: [CUSTOM ORDERS: e.g., Ed takes on a limited number of custom pieces when his schedule allows.] Send details through the contact form. Ed will review your request and reply before any work begins.

settings.question: How should I care for my cutting board?
settings.answer: Hand wash with warm, soapy water and dry it right away, standing on edge. Don’t soak it or put it in the dishwasher. When the surface looks dry or dull, rub in a thin coat of [RECOMMENDED OIL OR BOARD CONDITIONER], let it soak in, and wipe off the extra.
